summary: Obfuscated preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes opaque 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which is itself obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (`_0xXXXX` identifiers and per-function string-lookup maps that indirect URLs, argument strings, and file paths). When Bun is not already present, `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime zip from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB file obfuscated with the same technique (shuffled string array `n7gIxM` plus rotator function `WV8StW` and hex-named variables) and is unrelated to the package's declared purpose as a React UI component library. The Bun runtime is fetched specifically so that this sibling file executes outside the normal Node module graph a reviewer would inspect. The effect is install-time execution of opaque code with the privileges of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
